audience: nonprofit fundraisers who manage donors and donations in Funraise

useCases.title: See recent donations
useCases.text: The AI lists donations with amount, date, supporter, form, campaign page, allocation and fees, for example from the last hours. You see who gave and how much.

useCases.title: Check recurring gifts and their next payment
useCases.text: The AI lists recurring gifts with status, frequency, amount, next payment date and supporter, and opens one for the last payment and cancel date.

useCases.title: Look up a supporter with notes and interactions
useCases.text: The AI finds a supporter by exact email, reads their profile, tags and household, and lists their notes and interaction log of calls, emails and meetings.

useCases.title: Review your donation forms and campaign sites
useCases.text: The AI lists donation and event forms with their custom questions, and campaign sites (fundraising pages) with their configuration. It needs the CREATOR role for forms.

useCases.title: Add a supporter, a note or an interaction
useCases.text: The AI creates a supporter record, adds a note to a supporter or household, or logs a call, email or meeting. Each call creates a new entry, so search by email before you add a supporter.

useCases.title: Create or complete a follow-up task
useCases.text: The AI creates a task linked to a supporter or a donation, with a title of up to 40 characters, or marks a task complete.
